item.title: Spanish Songwriter Guitarricadelafuente on Folk Music and Folklore, In-Studio
item.description: Spanish indie folk artist Guitarricadelafuente has come a long way since his days of posting covers on social media. Back then, he wasn’t only inspired by his own culture, but American folk music as well, reinterpreting songs of Woody Guthrie and Bob Dylan. Eventually finding his own vein within the art of storytelling, Guitarrica began drawing inspiration from folklore, viewing it as not a snapshot from the past, but “something that already lives within us”. item.title: Guitarricadelafuente - "En la noche más fría" (Soundcheck Podcast)
item.description: Guitarricadelafuente - "En la noche más fría" (Soundcheck Podcast) The young Spanish singer known as Guitarricadelafuente, or Guitarrica for short, does in fact play the guitar, but he’s best known for singing. Initially, he recorded covers, including songs by Woody Guthrie and Bob Dylan. But he soon began releasing his own work, drawing freely from old-style ballads, dance music, flamenco, and global pop. item.title: Sullivan Fortner Trio at Miller Theater
item.description: Sullivan Fortner Trio at Miller TheaterMarch 7. 7:30PM. $12.50-$44.00 Pianist Sullivan Fortner’s career began in New Orleans but is now centered here in NY, where he leads his own trio. He played in the late trumpeter Roy Hargrove’s band, and worked with singers Cecile McLorin Salvant, Samara Joy, and Paul Simon.
